description: This source file defines the ServerRequestFactory class implementing the ServerRequestFactoryInterface. It provides a method to create PSR-7 compliant ServerRequest objects, handling the HTTP method and server parameters.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create server request objects based on method, URI, and server parameters, implementing the PSR-7 ServerRequestFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ServerRequest instance with the specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters. Determines the method if not provided, or throws an exception if it cannot be inferred.
